span.p:
Ch00: Foundations Before Code
What is programming?
Why C?
Systems thinking
Learning strategies

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Ch01: How Computers Work
Binary & data
Logic gates
CPU: Fetch-Decode-Execute
Memory hierarchy
Abstraction layers

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Ch02: Setting Up Your Tools
Install a compiler
Terminal basics
Your first C program
Hello World explained

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Ch03: Variables & Data Types
int, float, char, double
Declaration & initialization
Type conversion

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Ch04: Operators & Expressions
Arithmetic, relational
Logical, bitwise
Assignment & increment

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Ch05: Control Flow
if/else, switch
Boolean expressions
Decision making

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Ch06: Loops & Iteration
while, for, do-while
break, continue
Nested loops

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Ch07: Functions
Parameters & return
Scope & lifetime
Recursion

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Ch08: Arrays & Strings
Contiguous memory
String functions
Multi-dimensional

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Ch09: ⭐ POINTERS ⭐
Addresses & dereferencing
Pointer arithmetic
Pointers & arrays
Function pointers

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Ch10: Memory Management
Stack vs Heap
malloc & free
Memory leaks
Valgrind

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Ch11: Structures & Unions
Struct, typedef
Nested structures
Memory layout

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Ch12: File I/O
fopen, fclose
Reading & writing
Binary vs text

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Ch13: Data Structures
Linked lists
Stacks & queues
Trees & hash tables
Graphs

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Ch14: Algorithms
Big O notation
Searching & sorting
Divide & conquer
Recursion revisited

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Ch15: How Languages Work
Compilers vs interpreters
Type systems
Programming paradigms
Where C fits in

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Ch16: Capstone Project
Design → Implement
Test → Debug
Present your creation!
USE EVERYTHING YOU LEARNED
